common.app_description: Clinical research data quality pre-check tool

home.title: Clinical Dataset Checker
home.subtitle: Check your data quality before statistical analysis
home.description: This tool helps you identify data quality issues in your CSV or XLSX files before you begin statistical analysis. All processing happens locally in your browser — no data is ever uploaded to servers.

features.title: Features
features.local: Local Processing: All analysis happens in your browser
features.privacy: Privacy First: No data leaves your device
features.formats: Multiple Formats: CSV and XLSX support
features.export: Export Results: HTML, JSON, and CSV reports

home.supported_formats: Supported Formats: CSV (comma, semicolon, tab-separated), XLSX (single sheet)
home.limitations: Limitations: This tool checks data structure and quality only. It does not provide clinical interpretation, automatic repair, or verify regulatory compliance.

import.title: Import Data
import.drag_drop: Drag and drop your CSV or XLSX file here
import.header_row_help: Which row contains your column headers?
import.id_column_help: Select the column that uniquely identifies participants (optional)
import.longitudinal: Is this longitudinal data? (one participant, multiple rows)
import.missing_markers_help: Custom codes for missing values (comma-separated, e.g., NA, N/A, unknown)
import.date_columns_help: Select columns that should contain dates (ISO format YYYY-MM-DD expected)

results.title: Quality Check Results
results.blocker_notice: Blocker-level issues were found. They indicate the data cannot be reliably interpreted with the current configuration — review them before exporting.

export.title: Export Results
export.blocker_notice: Blocker-level issues are present. The report will be marked as containing unresolved blockers.
export.blocker_ack: I have reviewed the blocker issues and want to export anyway.

about.title: About
about.description: Clinical Dataset Checker is a local-first tool for pre-checking data quality in clinical research datasets.

limitations.title: Tool Limitations
limitations.not_clinical_tool: This is not a clinical decision-support tool
limitations.no_diagnosis: Does not provide diagnosis or prognosis
limitations.data_checks: Performs structural and quality checks only

privacy.title: Privacy & Data Handling
privacy.overview: All data processing happens in your browser. No data is ever sent to external servers.
privacy.local_only_desc: All file parsing and analysis happens entirely on your device
privacy.no_uploads_desc: We do not transmit files, data values, or analysis results to any server
privacy.no_tracking_desc: No analytics, session replay, cookies, or third-party tools
privacy.no_accounts_desc: No registration, login, or user accounts required
privacy.verify: You can verify this using your browser's Developer Tools (Network tab)
privacy.exports: When you export reports, files download directly to your device

header_empty.title: Empty Column Header
header_empty.description: One or more columns have empty header names
header_empty.action: Provide names for empty columns or confirm they should be included

header_duplicate.title: Duplicate Column Names
header_duplicate.description: Two or more columns have identical names (after normalization)
header_duplicate.action: Rename duplicate columns to make them unique

row_empty.title: Empty Rows
row_empty.description: Complete rows with all cells empty
row_empty.action: Verify whether these rows should be removed or if they represent missing data entries

column_empty.title: Empty Columns
column_empty.action: Review if these columns should be removed

missing_values.title: Missing Values
missing_values.description: Cells marked as missing (empty, null, or your specified missing markers)
missing_values.action: Review the pattern and proportion of missing data; consider whether analysis can proceed

exact_duplicate_rows.title: Duplicate Rows
exact_duplicate_rows.description: Identical records appearing more than once
exact_duplicate_rows.action: Verify if duplicates are intentional (e.g., replicates) or data entry errors

duplicate_id.title: Duplicate IDs
duplicate_id.description: ID values appearing more than once
duplicate_id.action: Confirm if this is expected (longitudinal data) or if each ID should be unique

mixed_types.title: Mixed Data Types
mixed_types.description: Single column contains mix of numbers, text, dates, or boolean values
mixed_types.action: Review the column; you may need to standardize types before analysis

numeric_parse_ambiguity.title: Numeric Format Ambiguity
numeric_parse_ambiguity.description: Numbers use non-standard separators (commas, periods, spaces)
numeric_parse_ambiguity.action: Clarify whether commas represent thousands separators or decimal points

invalid_date_candidate.title: Invalid Date Format
invalid_date_candidate.description: Cells cannot be parsed as dates
invalid_date_candidate.action: Review date format; consider standardizing to ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD)

date_order.title: Date Order Issue
date_order.description: End date is earlier than start date
date_order.action: Verify dates; this may be valid for retrospective studies

constant_column.title: Constant Column
constant_column.description: Column contains only one unique value
constant_column.action: Consider whether this column is necessary for analysis

high_cardinality_category.title: High Cardinality Category
high_cardinality_category.description: Text column has unusually many unique values (>50% unique)
high_cardinality_category.action: Verify this is not an ID or free-text field; review for standardization needs

outlier_iqr_flag.title: Potential Outliers (IQR)
outlier_iqr_flag.description: Numeric values flagged as outliers by IQR method (±1.5*IQR from quartiles)
outlier_iqr_flag.action: Review outliers; verify they are valid measurements, not data entry errors

possible_outcome_leakage.title: Possible Outcome Leakage
possible_outcome_leakage.description: Column name suggests it may contain outcome or result information
possible_outcome_leakage.action: Verify this column is not accidentally using information from the outcome variable

errors.file_unsupported: This file format is not supported. Please use CSV or XLSX.
errors.file_too_large: File exceeds 25 MB limit. Please choose a smaller file.
errors.row_column_limit: Data exceeds limits: 100,000 rows or 500 columns.
errors.header_duplicate_error: Duplicate column names found. Please rename them before continuing.
errors.parse_error: Unable to read this file. Please check that it's valid CSV or XLSX.

errors.unknown_error: An unexpected error occurred. Please refresh and try again.
